name: Prefix-Sum Capacity Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit bitwise shifts and binary algebraic target with a sequence of capacities defined by an additive prefix sum. The target is reframed as the sum of all capacities from 1 to 3k. This removes all bitwise syntax and powers of 2, forcing models to deduce the exact cover property logically from the fact that the required sum equals the sum of all distinct available capacities, rather than pattern-matching bitwise operators.
